name: OG Nami
description: ogNAMI is the fee-sharing token of nami, a unified multichain DeFi protocol. Staked ogNAMI (sogNAMI) earns 10% of the swap fees from nami's permissioned pools across all supported chains, paid in USDC each epoch. ogNAMI has a fixed supply of 250,000, designed to shrink over time through protocol buybacks and burns.
